headline: Storm Shifts to Weathered Expanse as Callahans Passage Falls Silent
war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have rearranged the map of the storm. Callahans Passage, so long the seesaw, has gone quiet — no base action in two hours, the guns cooling from their late peak, the Wardens still masters of all ten works. The thunder has rolled instead to Weathered Expanse, where forty-one base actions stand logged in a day, Necropolis and Spirit Watch each fought over eighteen times, the firing unabated as this edition went to press; six of nine posts there fly Warden colours, one lies wrecked. Stlican Shelf burns on about The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, the Wardens ahead five works to four. Stonecradle's Long Fast was contested again near press time, though the map moves little. In the Dead Lands no post has fallen these six hours, yet casualty returns swell at a fearful rate; Loch Mor likewise logs the war's heaviest hourly losses without one change of flag. Fishermans Row, after a day of seesaw at Arcadia and Eidolo, rests uneasy and still. By our count the Colonials hold 256 works to the Wardens' 176; the ruins once reported at Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stand re-manned. It is the war's one-hundred-forty-third day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
